attrs.title: 选中节点时突出相关连接

attrs.className: node-method-link nodrag nopan h-auto max-w-full items-start justify-start gap-1 rounded-none p-0 text-left whitespace-normal hover:bg-transparent

attrs.aria-label:
assistantOpen
                    ? '收起工作项 Assistant'
                    : '展开工作项 Assistant'
attrs.title: assistantOpen ? '收起侧栏' : '展开侧栏'

attrs.disabled:
busy ||
          dirty ||
          (!!work?.draftId &&
            work.draftId !== work.adoptedId &&
            work.draftId !== sourceChoice &&
            !replaceDraft)
